description: Lane surface drawn (simplest drivable state). diLaneSurface.cpp L123 Draw returns unless m_laneLen>0 && sta_Navi==NAVI_ON && sta_vehicleConditionShow!=RET_SHOW. m_laneLen/m_lane are loaded from DiDcGetLanesPicture(len) (diAEControl.cpp DI_AEC_Lane_Show L1133), driven by the lane data mem fields (len>0). sta_Navi==NAVI_ON requires POWER_ON(val_power=3) and val_naviStatus in {2,3} (diAEControl.cpp L351-361). val_naviStatus is overwritten each cycle at L152 by DiDcGetNavigationETH, so mem val_naviStatus=3 is the acceptable input driver (getter is the runtime someip path). gear!=1 keeps sta_vehicleConditionShow=RET_SHOW_NOT, satisfying the RET_SHOW != sta_vehicleConditionShow gate. One lane-detect signal active -> lane line texture rendered.

mem.desc: gear!=1 keeps sta_vehicleConditionShow=RET_SHOW_NOT, opening the Draw gate
